transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this month's capital-distribution meeting. As you know, the company has requested approval for a special dividend of up to $8,000,000 following a profitable quarter, and we currently have $12,000,000 in unrestricted cash on hand. Before I can finalize this proposal, I need each of you to report any items that must be reflected before we set the distribution amount. Under our committee's distribution policy, when a special dividend is approved, the amount is set at the maximum legally distributable amount identified by financial control — not at an arbitrary lower figure. So it's critical that we hear from all relevant parties. Financial control, pension treasury, and corporate legal — please walk us through anything we need to account for.

Does everyone confirm that understanding before I issue my decision?
